The reports of the independent registered public accounting firm, consolidated financial statements, and notes to consolidated financial statements are presented in Item 15 of this Form 10-K. Item 9. Changes in and Disagreements with Accountants on Accounting and Financial Disclosure. None. Item 9A. Controls and Procedures. Evaluation of Disclosure Controls and Procedures Disclosure controls and procedures are designed to provide reasonable assurance that information required to be disclosed in Eaton's reports filed or submitted under the Exchange Act is recorded, processed, summarized and reported within the time periods specified in the Securities and Exchange Commission's rules and forms. Disclosure controls and procedures include, without limitation, controls and procedures designed to ensure that information required to be disclosed in Eaton's reports filed under the Exchange Act is accumulated and communicated to management, including Eaton's Principal Executive Officer and Principal Financial Officer, to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure. Pursuant to Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) of the Exchange Act, an evaluation was performed under the supervision and with the participation of Eaton's management, including the Principal Executive Officer and Principal Financial Officer, of the effectiveness of the design and operation of the Company's disclosure controls and procedures. Based on that evaluation, the Principal Executive Officer and Principal Financial Officer concluded that Eaton's disclosure controls and procedures were effective at a reasonable assurance level as of December 31, 2025. Internal Control over Financial Reporting Pursuant to Section 404 of the Sarbanes Oxley Act of 2002 and the rules and regulations adopted pursuant thereto, Eaton has included a report of management's assessment of the effectiveness of internal control over financial reporting, which is included in Item 15 of this Form 10-K. “Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm” relating to internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2025 is included in Item 15 of this Form 10-K. During the fourth quarter of 2025, there was no change in Eaton's internal control over financial reporting that materially affected, or is reasonably likely to materially affect, internal control over financial reporting. Management is currently evaluating the impact of businesses acquired in the past twelve months on Eaton's internal control over financial reporting. Item 9B. Other Information. Eaton Corporation plc (Eaton or the Company) is an intelligent power management company dedicated to protecting the environment and improving the quality of life for people everywhere. We make products for the data center, utility, industrial, commercial, machine building, residential, aerospace and mobility markets. We are capitalizing on the megatrends of the electrification, digitalization, and the reindustrialization of and growth of megaprojects in North America and increased global infrastructure spending, all of which are expanding our end markets and positioning Eaton for growth for years to come. We are strengthening our participation across the entire electrical power value chain and benefiting from momentum in the data center and utility end markets as well as a growth cycle in the commercial aerospace and defense markets. We are guided by our commitment to operate sustainably and with the highest ethical standards. Our work is helping to solve the world’s most urgent power management challenges and building a more sustainable society for people today and for future generations. Founded in 1911, Eaton has continuously evolved to meet the changing and expanding needs of our stakeholders. With revenues of $27.4 billion in 2025, the Company serves customers in 180 countries. Eaton electronically files or furnishes reports pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (Exchange Act) to the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), including annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K, and proxy and information statements, as well as any amendments to those reports. As soon as reasonably practicable, these reports are available free of charge through the Company's website at www.eaton.com. These filings are also accessible on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov. credit_strengths.text: Eaton's electrical and aerospace franchises delivered steady revenue growth across the three-year trend, with operating margin holding near the prior year and comfortably above the Industrials sector median, reflecting pricing power and mix in data center and utility end markets.

Gross leverage sits well below the sector median and eased slightly year over year, while net leverage on a cash-and-short-investment basis also compares favourably with peers, supporting a modest indicative financial risk profile.

key_risks.text: The debt note shows meaningful near-term maturities, including the Euro notes due in the coming year and a sizeable current portion of long-term debt, so refinancing execution in the euro and dollar markets is a recurring funding consideration rather than a remote event.

Disclosed risk discussion centres on integrating businesses acquired in the past twelve months, and management is still evaluating their impact on internal control over financial reporting; acquisition spend absorbs a material slice of free cash flow and adds execution and control risk.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage remains very strong and far above the sector median, although it declined year over year as interest expense rose with higher debt balances; operating income covers gross interest many times over, leaving ample cushion.

Operating cash flow exceeds capital expenditure plus dividends and buybacks combined, and free cash flow covers distributions with only a thin margin, so shareholder returns consume most discretionary cash after capex.

overall_credit_view.text: Eaton presents a modest indicative financial risk profile: leverage is below the sector median and coverage is far above it, with the leverage ratio sitting just under the next risk-band boundary, so a small EBITDA decline would shift the band.

Our forward view is that cash generation should continue to fund maturities and distributions, but the thin headroom on leverage and heavy buyback plus acquisition outlays mean we would monitor refinancing and integration closely; this is analyst judgement, not a rating.

credit_strengths.text: 伊頓的電氣與航空航天業務於三年趨勢中錄得穩定收入增長，營業利潤率維持於接近上一年水平，並穩居工業板塊中位數之上，反映其於數據中心及公用事業終端市場的定價能力與產品組合。
總槓桿率遠低於板塊中位數，並按年略為緩和，而以現金及短期投資計算的淨槓桿率亦較同業為佳，支持溫和的指示性財務風險狀況。

key_risks.text: 債務附註顯示可觀的短期到期債務，包括來年到期的歐元票據及相當規模的長期債務流動部分，故於歐元及美元市場的再融資執行屬經常性的資金考量，而非遙遠事件。
披露的風險討論集中於整合過去十二個月收購的業務，管理層仍在評估其對財務報告內部控制的影響；收購支出佔用自由現金流的重大部分，並增加執行及控制風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率維持非常強勁，遠高於板塊中位數，儘管因債務結餘上升帶動利息支出增加而按年下降；營業收入對總利息的覆蓋達多倍，留有充裕緩衝。
經營現金流超過資本支出加股息及回購的總和，而自由現金流對分派的覆蓋僅屬微薄，故股東回報消耗資本支出後的大部分酌情現金。

overall_credit_view.text: 伊頓呈現溫和的指示性財務風險狀況：槓桿率低於板塊中位數而覆蓋率遠高於之，槓桿比率僅略低於下一個風險區間界線，故EBITDA小幅下降即會令區間轉移。
我們的前瞻觀點是現金產生應可繼續為到期債務及分派提供資金，但槓桿率的微薄緩衝及沉重的回購加收購支出意味我們會密切監察再融資及整合；此為分析師判斷，並非評級。
